fields.name: Distinguished Service Commendation
fields.description: Recognizes a member or members (not currently on the Executive Council) who has rendered singular and highly significant service to the Fraternity that far exceeds the call of duty. Chosen by the Executive Council based on nominations sent to the Executive Director.

fields.name: National Volunteer of the Year
fields.description: Given annually to a national volunteer who has demonstrated exceptional work. It cannot be given to a current member of the Executive Council. Chosen by the Executive Council based on nominations from National Officers or Central Office Staff.

fields.name: Executive Director's Award
fields.description: Recognizes an individual who has rendered singular and highly significant service to the Fraternity. May be granted 'with distinction' to those who have given a career of service or whose service came at great personal cost. Nominated by the Executive Director, confirmed by a majority vote of the Executive Council.

fields.name: Meritorious Service Commendation
fields.description: Recognizes a member(s) who has rendered noteworthy service to the Fraternity that goes above and beyond the call of duty. A lesser version of the Distinguished Service Commendation. Chosen by the Executive Council based on nominations sent to the Executive Director.

fields.name: Commendation
fields.description: Recognizes a member(s) who has made a significant achievement in the service of the Fraternity that is within the normal line of duty. Chosen by the Executive Council based on nominations sent to the Executive Director.

fields.name: Special Commendation
fields.description: Recognizes a member(s) who has performed some special and significant action that has brought credit to the Fraternity. Unlike the other awards, this may be given for any noteworthy accomplishment, not only service to the Fraternity. Chosen by the Executive Council based on nominations sent to the Executive Director.

fields.name: Longevity of Service Award
fields.description: Established 2025. Recognizes a national officer or volunteer who has served 3, 5, and 10 years of service as a volunteer. Given at Convention or when a qualified volunteer leaves office after their anniversary but before Convention. Volunteers are automatically added based on longevity; years need not be consecutive.

fields.name: Student Achievement Recognition
fields.description: Recognizes student members who have made significant accomplishments in the pursuit of Theta Tau's vision and mission, outside of the Robert E. Pope Outstanding Student Member Award. Only student members are eligible. National Leadership submits nominations to the Central Office, to be approved by the Grand Regent or their designee.

fields.name: Outstanding Chapter Officer Award
fields.description: Recognizes student members who have shown excellence in the discharge of their duties as chapter Regent, Vice Regent, Treasurer, Scribe, or Corresponding Secretary. Each Regional Director/team may select one nominee for each office; the Executive Council selects the Officer of the Year for each office. Awarded at the National Convention or around July 1 in non-Convention years.

fields.name: Robert E. Pope Outstanding Student Member Award
fields.description: Yearly, each chapter selects an active member as their Outstanding Student Member; nominees are entered into consideration for the National Robert E. Pope Outstanding Student Member Award. Each OSM receives a certificate and OSM dangle. Granted automatically when the chapter's OSM verification flow completes; it is not nominated through the awards nomination process.

fields.name: Outstanding Convention Delegate
fields.description: Historical recognition of outstanding delegates to the National Convention.

fields.name: Schrader Award
fields.description: Recognizes the chapter with the highest overall Annual Report Score, as calculated in the Chapter Management Tool (CMT). Chapter must be in good standing. Given at Convention at the conclusion of the biennium. The winning chapter receives a monetary award of $700.

fields.name: Grand Regent's Chapter Award
fields.description: Established 2023. Recognizes a chapter that best embodies the spirit of the Fraternity, is in good standing, does not have an unarranged balance with the Central Office, and is not receiving Schrader or Founder's. Chosen by the Grand Regent based on nominations from Regional Directors. The winning chapter receives a monetary award of $500.

fields.name: Founder's Award
fields.description: Recognizes the chapter with the largest improvement in points since the previous convention. Chapter must be in good standing. Given at Convention at the conclusion of the biennium. The winning chapter receives a monetary award of $500.

fields.name: Outstanding Brotherhood Program
fields.description: Chapter Programming Award recognizing achievement in brotherhood programming. Chapters submit applications; winners receive a monetary award of $200.

fields.name: Outstanding Philanthropy Program
fields.description: Chapter Programming Award recognizing achievement in philanthropy programming. Chapters submit applications; winners receive a monetary award of $200.

fields.name: Outstanding Philanthropy Event
fields.description: Chapter Programming Award recognizing an outstanding philanthropy event.

fields.name: Outstanding Professional Development Program
fields.description: Chapter Programming Award recognizing achievement in professional development programming. Chapters submit applications; winners receive a monetary award of $200.

fields.name: Outstanding Media Program
fields.description: Chapter Programming Award recognizing achievement in media programming. Chapters submit applications; winners receive a monetary award of $200.

fields.name: Outstanding DEI Program
fields.description: Chapter Programming Award recognizing an outstanding diversity, equity, and inclusion program.

fields.name: Outstanding Newsletter
fields.description: Chapter Programming Award recognizing an outstanding chapter newsletter.

fields.name: Outstanding Photography
fields.description: Chapter Programming Award recognizing outstanding chapter photography.

fields.name: Outstanding Video
fields.description: Chapter Programming Award recognizing an outstanding chapter video.

fields.name: Outstanding Website
fields.description: Chapter Programming Award recognizing an outstanding chapter website.

fields.name: Outstanding Social Media
fields.description: Chapter Programming Award recognizing an outstanding chapter social media presence.

fields.name: Member Miles Award
fields.description: Historical Chapter Programming Award recognizing chapter member travel and participation.

fields.name: 700 Club
fields.description: Historical recognition for chapters achieving an Annual Report Score of 700 or more.

fields.name: Interfraternal Service Award
fields.description: Recognizes a member of the fraternal community for their service to the community and, by extension, to Theta Tau. Granted biennially at the National Convention at the discretion of the Executive Council, based on nominations sent from the Executive Director.

fields.name: Outstanding Advisor Award
fields.description: Recognizes a campus-based professional for their service to a chapter and, by extension, to Theta Tau. Granted biennially at the National Convention at the discretion of the Executive Council, based on nominations sent from the Executive Director.

fields.name: Convention Named to Honor
fields.description: Recognizes a member honored at a National Convention -- the member in whose honor the Convention is named (the Convention's 'Named to Honor'). Granted at the National Convention; the award year is the Convention year. Recorded directly, not through the awards nomination process.
